column1: # youtube components: kind  name  key  description  flags (see lib/components.sh)
mode  search   -  search YouTube (enter runs the query)  default
mode  formats  -  a video's formats (--url URL)           hidden
action  play      ctrl-o  play in mpv (detached)                       silent
action  audio     alt-a   play the audio in this terminal (q returns)  foreground
action  browser   alt-O   open in the browser                          silent
action  mp3       alt-m   save as mp3 (yt-dlp and ffmpeg)              foreground
action  download  alt-d   download the video; formats: the selected formats, a video and an audio one merged, a video-only one with the best audio  foreground
